item.title: Shimai Intsui ~Houfuku no Renkin Torihiki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gracious
  • 発売日: 2009-11-27
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姉妹淫墜～報復の錬金取引～
  • 英語名: Shimai Intsui Houfuku no Renkin Torihiki

あらすじ

The main character is an alchemist in prison. One day, he meets Mikage, a necromancer. She says, “Can you create a human’s body as well?” “Yes. If I could get out of here.” “I would like you to create my younger sister’s body.” “Of course, I can’t create anything from nothing.” In front of Mikage and Reina, her younger sister, he thinks about something evil….

item.title: Chijoku Koukyuu ~Kegasareta Ouzoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gracious
  • 発売日: 2008-12-26
  • スコア: 6.68/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恥辱皇宮～穢された王族～
  • 英語名: Chijoku Koukyuu Kegasareta Ouzoku

あらすじ

There is a small country at the edge of the continent called Alcberde. Big countries around it are now at war, but Alcberde is protected by Veldor, a neighboring country, and people in Alcberde live a peaceful life. But one day, Kainz Heiz, the biggest country in the area, invades Veldor all of a sudden and easily occupy the country. Kain, the first prince of Veldor, heads for Alcberde with conspiracy in mind….
